name: Gargouille Coela
source:
"I will take recompense for my slain brethren."

A girl from a destroyed planet.
She vows to take revenge on the one who destroyed her planet.
With her legendary sword Coelacanth in hand, she's going on a rampage.
Since she was born on a planet of sand, she longs for places of water.
